name: Nightora
summary:
Nightora turns your Quest into a home theater for the library you already have.

• Big-screen browsing: Home, Discover, Movies, Shows, Anime, Live TV and Catalogs, with rich detail pages, ratings and trailers.
• Native playback: a hardware-accelerated video player with subtitle and audio-track choices and subtitle timing adjustment.
• Set up from your PC: open Nightora on your computer, choose Send to device, and your account, add-ons and settings arrive on the headset. No typing passwords in VR.
